facts.description: Current approved class identity and workstation context in the heading.
Correct local precedence and current approved station rule.

expected_value.station_topology: two 12-well strips for one four-student station
expected_value.pairing: A/B on Strip 1 and C/D on Strip 2

facts.description: Required process organization without inflating the main-step count.

sections: Run, validate, and report the ELISA
expected_value.support_block: calculations and decision checks may be outside the numbered sequence

facts.description: All labeling, exchange, repetition, recording, and disposal requirements.
facts.expected_value: Label the yellow sample tube and sharing transfer pipet with initials; for each exchange transfer the full approximately 750 µl sample, gently mix by pipetting, take back approximately half/about 750 µl, record the partner, repeat with three different partners in order, then discard the sharing pipet.

facts.description: Per-station strip assignment and complete per-strip triplicate pattern.
facts.expected_value: Two strips per station: Strip 1 serves A/B and Strip 2 serves C/D. Each strip is labeled as 3 positive controls, 3 negative controls, 3 wells for the first student, and 3 wells for the second student.

facts.description: Initial 50 µl loading destinations and source-tip isolation.
facts.expected_value: On each strip load 50 µl into every assigned well: positive control to + wells, negative control to - wells, and each paired student sample to its three wells. Use a dedicated tip for each source liquid on that strip and never move a tip between strips.

facts.description: Complete antigen-detection stage order, quantities, waits, and stage wash counts.
expected_value: Samples/controls: 50 µl per well, wait 5 minutes, wash 2 times
Primary antibody: 50 µl per well, wait 5 minutes, wash 2 times
Secondary antibody: 50 µl per well, wait 5 minutes, wash 3 times
Substrate: 50 µl per well, wait/read at 5 minutes, no subsequent wash

facts.description: Derived timed incubation and wash totals for the active two-strip station.
Shared liquid issue quantities after the approved 10% reserve.
Minimum fresh micropipette-tip count under source and strip isolation.
One safe wash cycle and strip-specific wash-pipet rule.
facts.expected_value: For one strip, invert and gently tap over paper towels to drain, discard the wet top towel or move to a fresh zone, fill every well with wash buffer without splashing into neighboring wells, then invert and gently tap again. Reuse only the wash-buffer transfer pipet assigned to that strip; never use it for samples/reagents or the other strip.

facts.description: Independent all-replicate control validation and invalid-strip action.
facts.expected_value: Validate each strip independently. A strip is valid only when all three positive-control wells are blue and all three negative-control wells are colorless. If not, mark the strip invalid, do not interpret either student on it, and notify the instructor.

facts.description: Exact student replicate decision matrix on a valid strip.
Current read window and validity-gated reporting/tracing rule.
facts.expected_value: Read and record from 5 through 10 minutes after substrate. Preserve partner order. Trace a possible link only from a valid strip with a definite positive student call; do not trace invalid or indeterminate results.

facts.description: Current safety response plus exclusion of obsolete or out-of-scope material.

required_safety: wash hands with soap before and after
eye splash: immediate eyewash for at least 15 minutes and alert instructor
excluded: cancelled, makeup, draft, or superseded schedule records

calculation_notes.well_basis: Two 12-well strips × 12 wells × 50 µl = 1200 µl for each reagent applied to all wells before reserve.
calculation_notes.control_basis: Two strips × 3 control wells × 50 µl = 300 µl for each control before reserve.
calculation_notes.reserve: Multiply shared controls and common reagents by 1.10; do not reserve or pool student samples.
calculation_notes.tips: Seven dedicated source tips per strip × two strips = 14 fresh micropipette tips. Sharing and wash transfer pipets are separate.
calculation_notes.time: Four 5-minute waits = 20 timed minutes, excluding handling time.
calculation_notes.washes: 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 wash cycles per strip; two strips produce 14 strip-wash cycles.
